rule.description: CFOClose: prevent browser and edge storage of documents and private responses
rule.expression: http.host in {"cfoclose.com" "www.cfoclose.com"} and not (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/assets/") and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} and http.response.code eq 200 and any(http.response.headers["cache-control"][*] contains "public") and any(http.response.headers["cache-control"][*] contains "immutable") and len(http.response.headers["set-cookie"]) eq 0 and (lower(http.response.headers["content-type"][0]) contains "javascript" or lower(http.response.headers["content-type"][0]) contains "text/css" or starts_with(lower(http.response.headers["content-type"][0]), "image/") or starts_with(lower(http.response.headers["content-type"][0]), "font/")))
